title: Israel’s Disobedience

questions.question: Where did the angel of the Lord come from to speak to Israel?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:1 (ESV): "Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim..."

questions.question: What did the people do after the angel spoke?
options: They lifted up their voices and wept
questions.correctAnswer: They lifted up their voices and wept
questions.explanation: Judges 2:4 (ESV): "...the people lifted up their voices and wept."

questions.question: What arose after the generation of Joshua died?
options: Another generation who did not know the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Another generation who did not know the Lord
questions.explanation: Judges 2:10 (ESV): "And there arose another generation after them who did not know the LORD or the work that he had done for Israel."

questions.question: What did the Lord raise up to save them?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:16 (ESV): "Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them."

questions.question: What happened when the judge died?
options: They turned back and were more corrupt than their fathers
questions.correctAnswer: They turned back and were more corrupt than their fathers
questions.explanation: Judges 2:19 (ESV): "But whenever the judge died, they turned back and were more corrupt than their fathers..."

questions.question: What does the name Bochim mean?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:5 (ESV): "So they called the name of that place Bochim." (Footnote: Bochim means Weepers).

questions.question: How old was Joshua when he died?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:8 (ESV): "And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110 years."

questions.question: Which specific gods did the Israelites serve?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:13 (ESV): "They abandoned the LORD and served the Baals and the Ashtaroth."

questions.question: What did the Lord say He would no longer do?
options: Drive out the nations before them
questions.correctAnswer: Drive out the nations before them
questions.explanation: Judges 2:21 (ESV): "I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations that Joshua left when he died..."

questions.question: Why did God leave the nations?
options: Because the nations were too strong
questions.explanation: Judges 2:22 (ESV): "in order to test Israel by them, whether they will take care to walk in the way of the LORD..."

questions.question: Where was Joshua buried?
options: Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim
questions.explanation: Judges 2:9 (ESV): "And they buried him within the boundaries of his inheritance in Timnath-heres..."

questions.question: The Angel of the Lord said, "I will never ____"
questions.explanation: Judges 2:1 (ESV): "...I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.’"

questions.question: What were the people commanded NOT to do with the inhabitants of the land?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:2 (ESV): "...and you shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; you shall break down their altars."

questions.question: What comparison is used for the "hand of the Lord" against them?
options: As the Lord had warned and sworn to them
questions.correctAnswer: As the Lord had warned and sworn to them
questions.explanation: Judges 2:15 (ESV): "...the hand of the Lord was against them for harm, as the Lord had warned..."

questions.question: Was the Lord legally "with the judge"?
questions.explanation: Judges 2:18 (ESV): "Whenever the LORD raised up judges for them, the LORD was with the judge..."

key_verse_text: And there arose another generation after them who did not know the LORD or the work that he had done for Israel. (ESV)
